string.text: While the battle scoreboard (Tab) is open, show each side's total troops including reinforcements still to come, the size of the next wave and how many more casualties it takes before it arrives. Turning this off also turns off the alerts.
Off: only your own side is shown, if you'd rather not know how many enemies are still coming.
Alert on the way to reinforcements
Show a message once per wave when a side has taken enough casualties to be partway to its next reinforcements, for example "Enemies are halfway to getting reinforcements".
How far a side has to be towards its next wave before the alert shows. 50% means half of the casualties the wave needs.
Show a message each time a reinforcement wave has arrived, with how many troops it brought.
Show the alerts for your own side, including allies.
Show the alerts for the enemy side.
Off: alerts appear as coloured lines in the chat log (green for your side, red for the enemy). On: they appear as the large notification at the top of the screen.

Show the raw numbers in the chat log each time you open the scoreboard, and a message each time a reinforcement wave arrives with the size that was predicted. Useful for checking the mod; turn it off for normal play.
